coloc.denAll: Sum over all selection pixels (Manders 1993, Costes 2004)

coloc.note: Both images must have the same size and bit depth. The selection of image 1 (if it is an area) is used for both. With manual or Costes thresholds a pixel is “above” a threshold when its value is greater than or equal to it (like ImageJ’s Threshold window); with no threshold, “above” means above zero.

about.intro: Advanced view: an ImageJ-style editor for the slice you chose in the Studio. It works on the lossless voxels of the dataset.
about.source: Several slices are flattened into one with Z Project; the stored data is 8-bit, so Max and Min stay 8-bit, Sum is 16-bit (exact up to 257 slices), Average, Standard Deviation and Median are 32-bit.
about.depth: Display changes (brightness, contrast, lookup tables, threshold overlay) never touch the pixels; Apply, filters and type changes do, and can be undone while memory allows.
about.deviations: Differences from ImageJ: Clear and Clear Outside use 0 (black) and Fill uses the maximum value, because fluorescence images have a dark background; Convert to Mask and Threshold Apply create a new image; Sum projection is 16-bit.
about.storage: Your work is saved in this browser as you go, so a crash or a closed tab does not lose it. Save as TIFF to keep a file.
about.tables: Table windows (lists, colocalization results, distributions) and plot windows are not kept when the page is reloaded: copy them or save them as CSV or PNG. Results stay saved with your work.
about.famDisplay: Image: brightness and contrast, threshold, lookup tables, type conversion, crop, duplicate and Z Project.
about.famSelect: Selections: rectangle, oval, polygon, freehand, line, segmented line, angle, points and the Wand; Specify, Enlarge, Fit Ellipse, Convex Hull, Create Mask and Create Selection; the ROI Manager with Measure and Multi Measure.
about.famBackground: Background and contrast: Subtract Background (rolling ball and sliding paraboloid) and Enhance Contrast (saturated pixels, Normalize, Equalize).
about.famFilters: Filters and math: Smooth, Sharpen, Find Edges, Gaussian Blur, Median, Mean, Minimum, Maximum, Unsharp Mask, Variance, Top Hat, Convolve, Despeckle, Remove Outliers, Remove NaNs and the Process > Math functions.
about.famBinary: Binary: Erode, Dilate, Open, Close, Outline, Fill Holes, Skeletonize, Distance Map, Ultimate Points, Watershed, Voronoi, and Find Maxima.
about.famMulti: Several images and channels: Image Calculator, Split Channels, Merge Channels, Arrange Channels and Rename.
about.famGeometry: Geometry and calibration: Rotate, Scale, Size, Canvas Size, Translate, Bin, Properties and Set Scale.
about.famMeasure: Measurements: Measure, Analyze Particles, Summarize, Distribution, Histogram and Plot Profile, with Set Measurements (shape descriptors, Feret, Redirect to, Limit to threshold).
about.famColoc: Colocalization: Pearson, Manders, Costes automatic threshold and Li's ICQ, with a 2D histogram.
about.missing: Stacks and 3D (hyperstacks, orthogonal views, 3D tools), macros, text and arrows, FFT and bandpass filters, Bio-Formats, surface plots, the RGB colour type and the Wand's Legacy mode.
